SFML 2.6.2 (Visual C++ 17 / Visual Studio 2022, 64-bit) is installed here by setup_sfml.bat.
The official SDK binaries are not bundled because this environment cannot fetch them.
The installer checks all headers, debug/release .lib files, and DLLs before reporting success.
Official: https://www.sfml-dev.org/download/sfml/2.6.2/
